correctness.rationale: The exact affine recurrence yields R, Gamma, and the excitation offset s_pi. The four eigenvalues of the normalized two-qubit Choi partial transpose are reconstructed explicitly, giving N_pi and EB iff \(s_\pi(\Gamma-s_\pi)\ge R\); 2x2 PPT implies separability. The adjacent transposition shifts s by gamma_a gamma_b (nu_b-nu_a) times the positive survival factor of later contacts. Since \(\nu\le 1/2\) enforces \(s\le\Gamma/2\), both EB testing and negativity have the required monotonicity. The threshold discriminant and all equality cases follow. For equal damping of zero- and infinite-temperature contacts, the two strict monotone cubic polynomials have unique roots with the stated interval; both individual channels fail the PPT/EB condition throughout. The standalone finite rational/Kraus check ran successfully but is not used to prove unbounded quantifiers.

originality.rationale: The statement optimized over every permutation, including the exact all/some/none EB trichotomy and a nonempty sharp order-reversal window of two non-EB thermal contacts, is not present as an implication-equivalent theorem in the reviewed primary full texts or indexed scientific comparisons. Existing binary GAD composition, commutator, and single-channel PPT criteria are explicitly cited as prior and not claimed as novel. These prior formulas make the new theorem mathematically accessible, so overlooked derivations remain a real risk.
residual_risks: Because the 2015 and 2026 sources already contain exact GAD binary composition and commutator identities, the global sorting law may be derivable as a short unpublished or differently indexed corollary.
A prior thermal-bath scheduling article could present the same permutation optimization using Bloch affine maps rather than GAD/Choi terminology; source coverage is not guaranteed exhaustive.
The present statement is restricted to noninverted equilibrium populations, so it cannot be used to rank protocols with population inversion.

value.rationale: The physically motivated optimization question fixes every thermal contact and asks only for order; the theorem gives exact minimax Choi negativity and a deterministic entanglement-breaking yes/no envelope over factorially many schedules. Its two-root interval shows a qualitatively robust EB vs non-EB reversal with both component channels non-EB, rather than a small numerical improvement. The complete all/some/none phase trichotomy and boundary equalities address a real spectral property relevant to scheduled dissipative processing, without relying on any unproved downstream application.
